task_allocation.save: fresh copy of the same canonical OpenTTD save for every arm
task_allocation.task: the ready event supplies the same guarded three-tile A-to-C road task
task_allocation.independent_evaluator: OpenTTD engine guard in the shared session runtime

arms.adaptive: turns 1-2 gpt-5.6-luna low, then gpt-6-astra medium

hard_success_gate: model requests verify with road_visible=true and the independent engine evaluation reports success=true within nine model turns
primary_measurements: proposal publication to first useful feedback
durable calls, runtime frames, and contact sheets
failure_policy: retain the bounded independent failure score and do not retry an arm
interpretation_limit: the second fixed-order episode per arm is descriptive replication evidence, not a latency distribution, randomized causal estimate, or human comparison
